CSV407: The all-season solid Class 2 vest, and where we point crews replacing the discontinued CSV400. Solid panels front and back instead of mesh means it handles wind and drizzle better than a mesh-back vest — the difference that matters here from October to May — and those smooth panels take a printed or transferred company logo cleanly. Zip front with chest and lower pockets; decoration goes on the solid areas, never across the reflective tape, so the certification stays intact.
